source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 7 (PDF 220-233), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 7 (Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line (TOC: 'Kinematics')) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 A particle moves along a straight line with \(x(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t\) (\(x\) in m, \(t\) in s), \(0 \le t \le 5\). Find (i) its velocity and acceleration (ii) when it is at rest (iii) its displacement and the distance travelled in the \(5\) s (iv) its average speed. (5 marks)
(Particle seedhi line par \(x(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t\) (m, s), \(0 \le t \le 5\), ke mutabiq chalta hai. (i) velocity aur acceleration (ii) kab rest mein hai (iii) \(5\) s mein displacement aur distance (iv) average speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(v\) aur \(a\) ke liye differentiate karein; jahan \(v = 0\) wahan particle mur sakta hai, is liye turning points ke darmiyan raaste ke tukre jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Average velocity uses displacement, so it can be negative or zero.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Particle \(t = 2\) se \(t = 4\) tak peeche aata hai (\(v\) manfi). Is liye distance mein yeh 4 m alag se jor'te hain, jabke displacement mein yeh kat jaata hai.

blocks.prompt:
2 Prove that \(a = v\dfrac{dv}{dx}\) when \(v\) is a function of the displacement \(x\). Hence show that a particle whose velocity is \(v = \sqrt{9 + 4x}\) moves with constant acceleration, and find its velocity when \(x = 4\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke jab \(v\), \(x\) ka function ho to \(a = v\dfrac{dv}{dx}\). Phir dikhayein ke \(v = \sqrt{9 + 4x}\) wala particle constant acceleration se chalta hai, aur \(x = 4\) par velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) ke zariye chain rule; phir diye gaye \(v(x)\) par formula lagayein.

book_ref.quote: If velocity \(v\) of the particle is given as a function of displacement \(x\): Using the Chain Rule:

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(a = v\dfrac{dv}{dx}\); yahan \(a = 2\) (constant) aur \(x = 4\) par \(v = 5\).

blocks.prompt:
3 The position of a particle is \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 21t^{2} + 60t\) (m, s). Find its velocity and acceleration at \(t = 1\), \(t = 3\) and \(t = 6\) s, and say each time in which direction it moves and whether it is speeding up or slowing down. (5 marks)
(Particle ki position \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 21t^{2} + 60t\) (m, s) hai. \(t = 1\), \(t = 3\) aur \(t = 6\) s par velocity aur acceleration nikalein, aur har dafa batayein ke kis simt mein hai aur raftaar barh rahi hai ya kam ho rahi hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(v\) ka sign simt batata hai; \(v\) aur \(a\) ke sign aik jaise to raftaar barhti hai, ulte to kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: At \(t = 1\) both \(v\) and \(a\) are negative (same sign), so the particle is speeding up in the negative direction.

steps: \(t = 1\): \(v = 24\), \(a = -30\): positive simt, ulte sign, raftaar kam
\(t = 3\): \(v = -12\), \(a = -6\): negative simt, aik jaise sign, raftaar zyada
\(t = 6\): \(v = 24\), \(a = 30\): positive simt, aik jaise sign, raftaar zyada
blocks.final_answer: \(t = 1\): raftaar kam; \(t = 3\): negative simt mein raftaar zyada; \(t = 6\): raftaar zyada.

blocks.prompt:
4 A delivery rider's displacement-time graph joins \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(15, 6)\), \(B(25, 6)\), \(C(45, 10)\) and \(D(60, 0)\) by straight lines (\(t\) in minutes, \(x\) in km). Find (i) the velocity on each stage in km/h (ii) the average velocity and (iii) the average speed for the whole journey. (5 marks)
(Delivery rider ka displacement-time graph \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(15, 6)\), \(B(25, 6)\), \(C(45, 10)\) aur \(D(60, 0)\) ko seedhi lines se jorta hai (\(t\) minutes, \(x\) km). (i) har hisse par velocity km/h mein (ii) poore safar ki average velocity (iii) average speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har hisse ki velocity = slope; km/min ko 60 se zarb de kar km/h; rukne ka waqt bhi gina jaata hai.

book_ref.quote: They help us easily determine whether an object is moving, stationary or accelerating.

steps: Distance \(= 20\) km, \(1\) h mein: average speed \(= 20\) km/h

blocks.prompt:
5 A family drives from home for \(1.5\) h at an average velocity of \(80\) km/h (point \(A\)), stops for \(0.5\) h (to point \(B\)) and then drives on in the same direction for \(1\) h to point \(C\). On the displacement-time graph \(A\) is \(8\) grid units above the time axis and \(C\) is \(11\) units above it. Find (i) the displacement of \(C\) from home (ii) the velocity during the last hour (iii) the average velocity for the whole journey. (5 marks)
(Aik khandaan ghar se \(1.5\) h \(80\) km/h ki average velocity se chalta hai (point \(A\)), \(0.5\) h rukta hai (point \(B\)), phir usi simt mein \(1\) h chal kar \(C\) par pohanchta hai. Graph par \(A\) time axis se \(8\) grid units aur \(C\) \(11\) units ooncha hai. (i) ghar se \(C\) ka displacement (ii) aakhri ghante ki velocity (iii) poore safar ki average velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehli drive se A ka displacement milta hai; is se vertical axis ka scale tay hota hai.

book_ref.quote: That known value fixes the scale of the vertical axis, and the scale gives the rise from B to C.

steps: \(B\) se \(C\): \(3\) units \(= 45\) km; \(C\) ka displacement \(= 165\) km
Kul time \(= 3\) h (rukna shamil); average velocity \(= 55\) km/h

blocks.prompt:
6 A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly to \(18\) m/s in \(6\) s. It keeps this velocity for \(10\) s and then slows down uniformly, coming to rest in \(4\) s. Sketch the velocity-time graph in words and find (i) the acceleration in the first and in the last stage (ii) the total displacement (iii) the average velocity. (5 marks)
(Car rest se chal kar \(6\) s mein yaksaan \(18\) m/s tak pohanchti hai, \(10\) s yehi velocity rakhti hai, phir \(4\) s mein yaksaan ruk jaati hai. Velocity-time graph bayan karein aur (i) pehle aur aakhri hisse ki acceleration (ii) kul displacement (iii) average velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration = slope; displacement = graph ke neeche trapezium ka area.

book_ref.quote: Study motion in different time intervals clearly and effectively

steps: Graph: \((0, 0)\) se \((6, 18)\), phir horizontal \((16, 18)\) tak, phir \((20, 0)\) tak
Pehla hissa \(a = 3\) m/s\(^{2}\); aakhri hissa \(a = -4.5\) m/s\(^{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
7 A car travels \(95\) km along a straight road. It starts with velocity \(u\) km/h, accelerates uniformly to \(60\) km/h in \(\frac{1}{2}\) h, keeps \(60\) km/h for \(1\) h and then slows down uniformly to rest in \(\frac{1}{4}\) h. Find (i) \(u\) (ii) the acceleration in the first half hour (iii) the retardation at the end. (5 marks)
(Car seedhi sarak par \(95\) km chalti hai. Woh \(u\) km/h se shuru ho kar \(\frac{1}{2}\) h mein yaksaan \(60\) km/h tak pohanchti hai, \(1\) h \(60\) km/h rakhti hai, phir \(\frac{1}{4}\) h mein yaksaan ruk jaati hai. (i) \(u\) (ii) pehle aadhe ghante ki acceleration (iii) aakhir ki retardation nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Displacement = graph ke neeche area; \(t = \frac{1}{2}\) par do trapeziums mein taqseem kar ke \(u\) nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Break the region into rectangles, triangles and trapeziums

steps: Aakhri hissa: slope \(= -240\) km/h\(^{2}\), yani \(240\) km/h\(^{2}\) retardation

blocks.prompt:
8 A velocity-time graph joins \((0, 0)\), \((2, 8)\), \((5, 8)\) and \((8, -4)\) by straight lines (\(t\) in s, \(v\) in m/s). Find (i) when the particle changes its direction of motion (ii) the displacement and (iii) the distance travelled in the \(8\) s. (5 marks)
(Velocity-time graph \((0, 0)\), \((2, 8)\), \((5, 8)\) aur \((8, -4)\) ko seedhi lines se jorta hai (\(t\) s, \(v\) m/s). (i) particle kab simt badalta hai (ii) displacement (iii) \(8\) s mein distance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Jahan \(v\) ka sign badle wahan simt badalti hai; upar ka area minus neeche ka area = displacement, jama = distance.

book_ref.quote: Distance moved backwards cancels part of the forward distance in the displacement

blocks.prompt:
9 The velocity of a particle is \(v(t) = t^{2} - 6t + 8\) m/s for \(0 \le t \le 5\). Find its displacement and the total distance travelled. (5 marks)
(Particle ki velocity \(0 \le t \le 5\) ke liye \(v(t) = t^{2} - 6t + 8\) m/s hai. Displacement aur kul distance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Displacement = \(v\) ka integral; distance ke liye jahan \(v\) ka sign badle wahan waqfa taqseem kar ke absolute values jama karein.

book_ref.quote: The integral \(\int v\,dt\) over the whole interval gives \(A_{1} - A_{2}\) automatically, because the part below the axis comes out negative.

blocks.prompt:
10 A particle moves along a straight line with constant acceleration \(a\). At \(t = 0\) it is at \(x = 0\) with velocity \(u\). Derive \(v = u + at\) and \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\). (5 marks)
(Particle seedhi line par constant acceleration \(a\) se chalta hai. \(t = 0\) par \(x = 0\) aur velocity \(u\) hai. \(v = u + at\) aur \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = \frac{dv}{dt}\) ko integrate karein, phir \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\) ko; har constant shuru ki shart se nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Suppose a particle moves along a straight line with constant acceleration

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(v = u + at\) aur \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\).

blocks.prompt:
11 Using \(v = u + at\) and \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\), prove that \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\). Verify it for \(u = 3\) m/s, \(a = 2\) m/s\(^{2}\), \(t = 4\) s. (5 marks)
(\(v = u + at\) aur \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) se saabit karein ke \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\). \(u = 3\) m/s, \(a = 2\) m/s\(^{2}\), \(t = 4\) s ke liye tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(t\) ko khatam karein: \(t = \frac{v - u}{a}\) doosri equation mein rakh kar simplify karein.

book_ref.quote: By simplification, we get:

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\) (diye gaye values ke liye dono taraf \(112\)).

blocks.prompt:
12 A car moving at \(72\) km/h is brought to rest with uniform retardation in a distance of \(40\) m. Find (i) the retardation (ii) the time taken to stop (iii) the velocity of the car after it has covered \(30\) m. (5 marks)
(\(72\) km/h se chalti car yaksaan retardation se \(40\) m mein ruk jaati hai. (i) retardation (ii) rukne ka waqt (iii) \(30\) m tay karne ke baad velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle m/s mein badlein; time diya nahin, is liye pehle \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\).

book_ref.quote: Which equation when? Each equation links four of the five quantities

blocks.prompt:
13 A car starts from rest with a uniform acceleration of \(2\) m/s\(^{2}\) for \(10\) s, then moves with constant velocity for \(30\) s and finally decelerates uniformly to rest in \(5\) s. Find the maximum velocity, the deceleration and the total distance. (5 marks)
(Car rest se \(10\) s \(2\) m/s\(^{2}\) ki yaksaan acceleration se chalti hai, phir \(30\) s constant velocity se, aakhir mein \(5\) s mein yaksaan ruk jaati hai. Maximum velocity, deceleration aur kul faasla nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har hissa alag equations of motion se hal karein aur faasle jama karein.

book_ref.quote: To relate these quantities, we use the equations of motion.

blocks.final_answer: Maximum velocity \(20\) m/s; deceleration \(4\) m/s\(^{2}\); kul faasla \(750\) m.

blocks.prompt:
14 A train moving at \(10\) m/s accelerates uniformly at \(0.4\) m/s\(^{2}\) until its velocity is \(20\) m/s. Find (i) the time taken (ii) the distance covered in this time (iii) the distance covered in the last \(5\) s of this time. (5 marks)
(\(10\) m/s se chalti train \(0.4\) m/s\(^{2}\) ki yaksaan acceleration se \(20\) m/s tak pohanchti hai. (i) waqt (ii) is dauran faasla (iii) is waqt ke aakhri \(5\) s mein faasla nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri \(5\) s ka faasla do positions ka farq hai: \(x(25) - x(20)\).

book_ref.quote: Equation (2) reads: final velocity = starting velocity + (gain per second)

blocks.prompt:
15 A particle moves along a straight line with acceleration \(a(t) = 6t - 4\) m/s\(^{2}\). At \(t = 0\) it is at the origin with velocity \(3\) m/s. Find \(v(t)\) and \(x(t)\), and the velocity and position at \(t = 2\) s. Show that the particle never comes to rest. (5 marks)
(Particle ki acceleration \(a(t) = 6t - 4\) m/s\(^{2}\) hai. \(t = 0\) par woh origin par \(3\) m/s velocity se hai. \(v(t)\), \(x(t)\) aur \(t = 2\) s par velocity aur position nikalein. Dikhayein ke particle kabhi rest mein nahin aata.)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration \(t\) par munhasir hai, is liye do dafa integrate karein; 'kabhi rest nahin' ke liye dikhayein ke \(v(t) = 0\) ka koi real hal nahin.

book_ref.quote: If \(a\) depends on \(t\) (as in Examples 9 and 10), integrate directly instead.

steps: Koi real hal nahin, \(v > 0\) hamesha: kabhi rest nahin

blocks.prompt:
16 A particle has acceleration \(a(t) = 2\cos t\). It starts from rest at \(x = 1\) when \(t = 0\). Find \(v(t)\) and \(x(t)\), and the velocity and position at \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) and at \(t = \pi\). (5 marks)
(Particle ki acceleration \(a(t) = 2\cos t\) hai. \(t = 0\) par woh \(x = 1\) par rest se chalta hai. \(v(t)\), \(x(t)\), aur \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(t = \pi\) par velocity aur position nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa integrate karein; doosra constant nikalte hue \(\cos 0 = 1\) yaad rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Writing \(\int \sin t\,dt = \cos t\) instead of \(-\cos t\).

blocks.prompt:
17 The acceleration of a particle is \(a(t) = \dfrac{4}{(t + 1)^{3}}\) m/s\(^{2}\) for \(t \ge 0\). It starts from rest at the origin. Find \(v(t)\), \(x(t)\) and the velocity and position at \(t = 1\) s. (5 marks)
(Particle ki acceleration \(t \ge 0\) ke liye \(a(t) = \dfrac{4}{(t + 1)^{3}}\) m/s\(^{2}\) hai. Woh origin par rest se chalta hai. \(v(t)\), \(x(t)\) aur \(t = 1\) s par velocity aur position nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a\) ko \(4(t + 1)^{-3}\) likh kar do dafa power rule lagayein.

book_ref.quote: fixing each constant from an initial condition

blocks.prompt:
18 A ball is thrown vertically upward from the ground with \(29.4\) m/s. Find (i) the maximum height (ii) the time to return to the ground (iii) the times at which it is \(24.5\) m above the ground. (5 marks)
(Gend zameen se \(29.4\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki jaati hai. (i) maximum height (ii) zameen par wapas aane ka waqt (iii) kin auqaat par woh zameen se \(24.5\) m ooncha hoti hai, nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Upar ki harkat: \(a = -g\). Top par \(v = 0\). Koi unchai do dafa aati hai: jaate hue aur aate hue.

book_ref.quote: the motion is called free fall or free vertical motion

blocks.prompt:
19 A ball is dropped from the top of a tower \(49\) m high. At the same instant another ball is thrown vertically upward from the foot of the tower with \(24.5\) m/s. Find when and at what height above the ground they meet. (5 marks)
(\(49\) m oonche tower ki chot'ti se aik gend giraayi jaati hai. Usi lamhe tower ke qadmon se doosri gend \(24.5\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki jaati hai. Kab aur zameen se kitni unchai par woh milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har gend ki zameen se unchai time \(t\) par likhein aur dono barabar karein.

book_ref.quote: The equations of motion for constant acceleration can also be used in vertical motion

blocks.final_answer: \(2\) s baad zameen se \(29.4\) m ki unchai par milti hain.

blocks.prompt:
20 A stone is thrown vertically downward with \(4.9\) m/s from the top of a cliff \(58.8\) m high. Find the time it takes to reach the ground and its velocity on impact. (5 marks)
(\(58.8\) m oonchi chattan se pathar \(4.9\) m/s se seedha neeche phenka jaata hai. Zameen tak waqt aur takrane par velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche ki harkat: \(a = g\). \(t\) ke liye quadratic hal karein, positive root lein.

book_ref.quote: If the particle moves downward, it accelerates toward the ground at the rate

blocks.prompt:
21 A ball is thrown vertically upward with \(9.8\) m/s from the top of a building \(39.2\) m high and falls to the ground beside it. Find (i) the greatest height of the ball above the ground (ii) the time it takes to reach the ground (iii) its speed on reaching the ground. (5 marks)
(\(39.2\) m oonchi imarat ki chhat se gend \(9.8\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki jaati hai aur saath zameen par girti hai. (i) zameen se sab se zyada unchai (ii) zameen tak waqt (iii) zameen par pohanchne par speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Poore sawal mein upar positive lein (\(a = -g\)); zameen chhat se \(x = -39.2\) m par hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Upar ko positive lene se zameen ki position \(-39.2\) m banti hai. Aakhri velocity ka minus sign sirf yeh batata hai ke gend neeche ja rahi hai; speed 29.4 m/s hai.
